title: Event Envelope
description: Standard event envelope for campus fruit marketplace events

eventType.description: Fully qualified event type, e.g. order.OrderCreated

eventVersion.description: Schema version for this event type

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred

producer.description: Name of the service that produced the event, e.g. order-service

sourceSequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within the producer

traceId.description: Distributed tracing identifier (W3C Trace Context format)

aggregateType.description: Type of the aggregate, e.g. Order

aggregateVersion.description: Version of the aggregate after applying this event

payload.description: Domain event data, schema is specific to eventType

tombstone.description: Whether this is a tombstone event (logical delete of aggregate)

userId.description: ID of the user who triggered this event
